reviewed_screen.interpretation: A total maximum centered difference <=0.1 implies pairwise relative likelihood changes no larger than exp(0.2) among these tested points only. Component flags detect large cancellations. Passing is only no large variation detected on this finite screen; failure requests further accuracy investigation. No gate on common offset alone.
reviewed_screen.limitations: Two accuracy levels do not establish asymptotic convergence.32 deterministic strata may miss tails, localized errors and remote modes. Stored baseline spectra are unavailable; full baseline component likelihoods are available. Higher-accuracy spectra are archived for later diagnosis only. Existing posterior qualification remains separate.

interpretation: The supplemental screen is still a32-point numerical diagnostic, never a posterior qualification or asymptotic convergence proof. Any remaining numerical variation requires its own follow-up. The failed original screen remains part of the provenance.
